card.title: STZ-5 KATYUSHA
card.text: When this unit deals combat damage, add equal amount of BLASTS to your hand.
card.flavorText: The STZ-5 Katyusha combined the Soviet STZ-5 tracked artillery tractor with the powerful BM-13-16 multiple rocket launcher. Produced at the Stalingrad Tractor Factory, the STZ-5 was designed as a military prime mover and became the most numerous purpose-built Soviet artillery tractor of WWII, with more than 9,900 produced. In 1941, a small number of STZ-5 tractors were fitted with 132 mm BM-13-16 launchers. These rare vehicles saw action in the fighting around Moscow in 1941 and Stalingrad in 1942. The Katyusha itself became one of the Red Army’s most distinctive weapons. Its rockets were less accurate than conventional artillery, but a battery could unleash a devastating barrage within seconds and then quickly relocate before enemy batteries could respond. Katyushas were mounted on many different vehicles during the war, including trucks, tanks and artillery tractors, with the STZ-5 representing one of the earliest tracked platforms for the launcher.
